name: Swing Shot
design_intent:
PHYSICS-LAB circuit 4, course 3 of 4. TEACHES: the OSCILLATING cannon — the barrel sweeps -80..-25 deg on a 2.8s period (Cannon.gd: smooth sine, mid -52.5 amp 27.5) and auto-fires after hold_s 0.9, so WHEN you fly in decides WHERE you land. The shot must clear a 1280px bumper tower and drop onto a needle pad on the far side. A cautious ALTERNATIVE route exists: a destructible crate plugs a 220px slot UNDER the tower — two bounces break it and open a long, fuel-hungry pad-ladder flight around.

BALLISTIC DERIVATION (gravity 1600, impulse 2600, muzzle = pivot + 230 along barrel; pivot 700,600):
THE WALL: bumper tower x1600-1760, y-200..1080. Clearance by phase (arc height at x=1600): fire at -45 -> y=-171, SPLAT into the tower face (top is -200) — the bumper bounces you off, you fall, free retry. Fire at -50 -> y=-311 (clears by 110, tight). Fire at -55 -> y=-473 (clears comfortably). Fire at -80 -> apex 2560^2/3200 = 2049px above the muzzle (373) -> apex y=-1675, sails over but lands short. So the LOW third of the sweep splats, the HIGH third undershoots — the read is real.
THE NEEDLE (pad x4550-4870, top y950, w320 — the rules' minimum-generous landing): landing x by phase, solving 800t^2 - vy*t - drop = 0 from each muzzle: fire at -58 -> lands x=4933 (just long); -60 -> x=4767 (IN, 3.04s flight); -62 -> x=4584 (IN); -65 -> x=4276 (short, void). Raw window ~58.5-62.5 deg, BUT with ~3.0s of airtime the rider has air drift (340px/s) plus boost to correct several hundred px mid-flight, and full fuel to save a short landing — the effective window is ~57-64 deg and every miss is a free respawn. Sweep rate near -60 is ~59 deg/s (amp 27.5 * cos(phase) * 2*pi/2.8), so the true entry read is 'load as the barrel swings through steep-middle' — a phase feel, not a frame trick.
From the needle: goal plateau x5400-5900 (top y1000), gap 530px > spring drift reach ~527 and >> trampoline ~395 -> one clean BOOST hop to the goal_gate (5650,860).

THE CAUTIOUS ROUTE (the crate the cannon can NOT reach): the tower reaches down to y1080; a destructible crate (1600,1080 160x220, HIT hp2) plugs the slot between tower bottom and the void lip (y1300). The cannon only fires UP (-80..-25): every arc at x=1600 is either above the tower top or splats into the bumper face at y>-200, so no shot ever touches the plug — it is a FLYER'S door only. Route: boost from the start pad to the low refuel pad (900,1150 w220), ram the plug twice (any bounce >=300px/s; per DestructibleBlock.gd hit_cd 0.3s, and the crate bounces you back off each hit — recover with boost over the void lip), squeeze through the opened 220px slot (player ~92px), then climb the far pad-ladder: (2200,1150) -> (3100,1100) -> (4000,1050) -> needle pad, gaps 780/680/680px — each beyond spring drift (~527) -> a BOOST leg apiece, each pad touch +20 fuel. Slower, safer, teaches sustained fuel management vs one brave phase read.

MOVEMENT-TOOL-PER-GAP ANALYSIS (flight required):
- Start pad top y1000 -> cannon capture (r70 @ 700,600): 400px climb > trampoline 270 -> BOOST to load.
- Cannon route: 3000px+ of void start-to-needle, uncrossable by tank alone in one line at low altitude without the ladder (and the tower blocks the direct line anyway) -> cannon or ladder only.
- Ladder route gaps 500/780/680/680px: all > trampoline drift ~395, three > spring drift ~527 -> BOOST every leg; plus the plug ram-and-recover is over the void lip.
- Needle -> goal: 530px > any bounce drift -> BOOST.
No gap on either route is bounce-crossable. Both routes are flight routes; the choice is phase-skill vs fuel-skill.

FUEL BUDGET: cannon route: ~25 to load, flight free, land with ~75+, goal hop ~15. Ladder route: ~30 to reach the plug + two ram-recover cycles (~20) + 4 boost legs (~25-30 each) against +20 per pad touch — arrives at the needle around 30-50; tight but positive, and a dry tank means a bounce-wait on a pad to re-approach (pads refund on touch). Falls are free respawns; the plug STAYS broken after a respawn (in-run persistence), so the cautious route never re-tolls.

FAIRNESS: the aim-arc telegraph (Cannon.gd draws the sweep span) shows the whole -80..-25 fan before you commit; the loaded fuse ring shows the 0.9s hold; the tower is a bumper (splats bounce off, never kill); explicit bounds top -2100 clears the -1675 max-phase apex with 400px+ margin.
hint: LOAD IN AS THE BARREL SWINGS STEEP
